title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract_snippet: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

title: Gödel Machines: Fully Self-Referential Optimal Universal Self-Improvers
abstract_snippet: We present the first class of mathematically rigorous, general, fully self-referential, self-improving, optimally efficient problem solvers.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
abstract_snippet: We propose Reflexion, an approach that endows agents with dynamic memory and self-reflection capabilities to improve reasoning and decision-making.

title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
abstract_snippet: We present the Darwin Gödel Machine, an open-ended self-improving agent that rewrites its own code guided by empirical evaluation.

title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
abstract_snippet: We introduce Adam, an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization of stochastic objective functions, based on adaptive estimates of lower-order moments.

title: AI Safety via Debate
abstract_snippet: To increase the robustness of AI systems, we propose training agents via self-play on a zero-sum debate game with a human judge.
